note: Corps of Engineers campground on a Center Hill Lake peninsula, in two loops (TCLP and FMIP), with a swim beach, boat ramp and fish-cleaning station. The lakeshore RV sites are 17, 18 and 26 on the point by the boat ramp, 28 and 31 either side of the swim beach and 6 on the east cove. --Claude
summary: Floating Mill: rec.gov confirms $26-30, 98 sites (59 RV/standard, 39 tent-only), 30/50 A + water, showers/dump, 48-ft max, 14-night limit; season 04-15..11-07 -> 04-08..10-31; count 105 -> 98. Lakefront KEPT on 17, 18, 26, 28, 31 and 6 (~10-20 m over open gravel/grass, pads ~1-1.7 m above summer pool); 33 is a view.
flags: WATERFRONT (lakefront kept): on Esri summer imagery the point by the boat ramp has RV sites 17 (36.04622,-85.76378), 18 (36.04613,-85.76381) and 26 (36.04610,-85.76405) ~8-15 m from the water over open gravel/grass with nothing between; 3DEP puts the pads at 199.1-199.2 m against Center Hill's 648-ft summer pool (197.5 m), ~1.6 m up on a gentle bank. 28 (36.04604,-85.76442) and 31 (36.04596,-85.76559; non-electric, 36 ft) sit at either end of the swim beach, ~12-16 m from the shore, the land in front partly beach; 6 (36.04574,-85.76315) is ~15 m from the east cove, ~1 m above pool. All are reservable by the night and take a 23-ft RV (32-36 ft). rec.gov's 'Lakefront' tag on 033 (36.04578,-85.76584) is a view: pad 201.7 m, ~4 m up behind trees.
SEWER: the catalog shows sewer 'Y' on one site (100, a 20-ft trailer site); the stored sewer false (note-derived) was left alone.
FIT: 11 of the 59 RV/standard sites are under 23 ft (032, 034 at 20 ft, 046 at 21 ft, FMIP 100-107 trailers to 20 ft); 48 take 23 ft or more.
